text.p: Doubletree Corp said on Wednesday it had named Richard Kelleher as president and chief executive officer.
The hotel management company said Kelleher is currently president and chief executive officer of its operating subsidiary, Doubletree Hotels Corp, and is a member of Doubletree's board.

"With our recent acquisition of Red Lion Hotels, we have dramatically increased our size and scope, and it is important for us to have a chief executive at the holding company level with responsibility for overseeing the newly combined corporation and exploring additional avenues for growth," said Richard Ferris, co-chairman of Doubletree Corp.
Doubletree is the exclusive franchisor of Doubletree Hotels, Doubletree Guest Suites and Club Hotels by Doubletree hotel brands.
